caption: The drawing depicts a single trivet with three different views presented on an off-white or beige background. The primary object is a cast iron trivet, characterized by an openwork design featuring a central heart shape and surrounding geometric patterns within a triangular frame with rounded edges. The trivet has a circular handle with a keyhole-shaped opening and three short legs to keep it elevated above a surface. In the upper center of the image, a bird’s-eye (top-down) view of the trivet is provided in grayscale, clearly displaying its open pattern, while below it, a side profile shows the legs and the trivet’s thickness. A scale in inches is present for reference beneath the side profile. The largest and most prominent element in the composition is an angled perspective view of the trivet in the lower right, highlighting its texture, thickness, and three-dimensional form. The drawing is rendered in graphite or pencil, giving the image a monochromatic gray tone throughout.
title: Trivet
